title: Swap XRP for USDC
description: Short XRP Mobile tutorial: swap XRP for USDC from a self custody wallet, with no exchange account. Where the minimum comes from, how to read the live quote, what the two fees actually are, what max slippage protects you from, and why a swap takes half a minute when an XRP payment takes four seconds: it is routed through NEAR Intents and crosses two networks, so it settles with two hashes instead of one.
lede: Turn XRP into a dollar stablecoin without an exchange account, without signing up anywhere. Here is how the swap works, and exactly what it costs.

steps.caption: Tap Swap
steps.body: From the wallet home, tap Swap. You pick what you are paying with on top and what you want underneath: XRP for USDC here, and the arrows in the middle flip the pair.

steps.caption: Type the amount
steps.body: Type what you want to swap, or take a percentage of your balance. The provider sets a minimum, two XRP at the time of recording, and the field tells you when you are under it.

steps.caption: Read the quote
steps.body: The quote fills in as you type: what you get, in USDC and in your own currency, and the rate it is based on. It is a live quote, not a promise, which is why it refreshes.

steps.caption: Check the terms
steps.body: The second step is where the real cost is. Two fees: the network fee, a hundredth of a cent, and the provider's, nought point eight eight percent. Max slippage of one percent is the worst rate you accept: if the market moves further than that while it settles, the swap fails instead of filling badly.

steps.caption: Sign with your PIN
steps.body: Confirm and swap, then your PIN. Your keys sign this on the phone, the same as any payment.

steps.caption: It crosses two networks
steps.body: This is not a trade on the XRP Ledger. Your XRP leaves the ledger and the swap is routed through NEAR Intents, which is why it takes half a minute instead of four seconds.

steps.caption: Two hashes, both pending
steps.body: The screen shows both legs while they settle: the intents hash and the NEAR transactions. Pending means it is still moving, not that it is stuck. Leaving the app does not cancel it.

steps.caption: Swapped
steps.body: Done. The hashes are now real, and your USDC balance is on the wallet home. Go again if you want to swap the rest.
